subject: Re: DARC status - closing out, and a checklist I want kept
body:
Closing the window on the 15th. Where we land:

DARC works for us, conditional on the simulator not leaking trivial signal. Rated plausibility on the corrected policy is 3.9/5 vs 2.7/5 uncorrected, 4 raters, agreement 0.72 - that is a result I'm happy to take forward.

The durable output is not the policy though, it's Yara's clock-artifact lesson. Before any future DARC-style run: check classifier accuracy first, and if it's above ~95% assume you have an artifact rather than a triumph. Yara, please write that as a short checklist, three bullets max.

Tomas - Paloma's rating tool has rater agreement tracking built in and worked well; worth a look for Evalline.

No extension. Q3 OKRs lock on 2026-06-26 and if we want the second-artifact hunt funded it goes in as its own line, not as a quiet rollover.

Ulla
